_note: Facts the build substitutes into the templates and partials as {{key}}. Change a fact here, never in the templates. The build fails if a value below appears hardcoded in a template, or if a stale review count or as-of month is left in the output. lead_api_base is the lead Worker's origin (no trailing slash); empty means the form only builds a text or an email and posts nothing anywhere. turnstile_site_key is the Cloudflare Turnstile site key for the send path; empty means Turnstile never loads. <!--if:key--> blocks in the templates switch copy on these two.
